items.text: Build the four host growth features (calculator, founding hosts, referrals, signup nudges)
Verify: lint, build, 54 new tests, production build typechecked against a generated Postgres client
Confirm production migrations: deploy logs show 20 of 20 applied, none pending
Set HOST_COMMISSION_RATE=0.1, FOUNDING_HOST_LIMIT=100, REFERRAL_REWARD_KES=2000 in Railway and confirm them live
Decide GUEST_SERVICE_FEE_RATE: still 12%, so guests still pay a markup at checkout, which contradicts the agreed 'guests pay the listed price' model
Decide HOST_PAY_CLEANING_FEE and HOST_PAY_LATE_CHECKOUT_FEE: both off, so hosts are not yet paid the cleaning or late check-out fees they are due
Investigate the Telegram bot conflict in production logs: two pollers are running the same bot token
